versions.content: Name Icu_ Activation Type Kind Enumeration Range ICU_ RISING_ EDGE -- An appropriate action shall be executed when a rising edge occurs on the ICU input signal. ICU_ FALLING_ EDGE -- An appropriate action shall be executed when a falling edge occurs on the ICU input signal. ICU_ BOTH_ EDGES -- An appropriate action shall be executed when either a rising or falling edge occur on the ICU input signal. Description Definition of the type of activation of an ICU channel. Available via Icu.h
